content: In order to optimize $\alpha $ automatically via gradient methods, we must compute the Jacobian of the entmax output w.r.t. $\alpha $. Since entmax is defined through an optimization problem, this is non-trivial and cannot be simply handled through automatic differentiation; it falls within the domain of argmin differentiation, an active research topic in optimization BIBREF25, BIBREF26.
